title: § 28-322.3 Locking before hurricane or strong wind conditions.

blocks.html:
If a hurricane or strong wind conditions are expected, the commissioner may order that large turbines equipped with passive locks be stopped and locked.
(L.L. 2019/098, 5/19/2019, eff. 11/15/2019; Am. L.L. 2019/147, 7/27/2019, eff. 11/15/2019)
